title: grid account statusline output
description: JSON output of grid account statusline [on|off] --json; internal/cli/account.go:250. With no word it reads and changes nothing. The app relays it to the page as it is (agentaccounts statusline.go:28-44).

on.description: True when the status line command in the settings file is Grid's own.

path.description: The Claude settings file read or changed.

kept.description: The person's own status line command that Grid runs after it notes the numbers; the empty string when they had none.
